title: GTX FPS BOOST
features:
Advanced technical GUI panel for Roblox with real-time monitoring.
It's free, no key required, and it doesn't require payment.
Displays FPS, ping, RAM usage, frame time, uptime, and server information.
Includes automatic memory cleaning and FPS optimization tools.
Dynamic graphics optimizer with low-quality performance mode.
“Boost” feature disables post-processing effects for higher FPS.
Multi-language support (Spanish and English).
Customizable accent colors and UI transparency.
Night mode and RTX-style visual enhancement mode.
Anti-AFK and Anti-Fling protection systems.
ESP system for showing player boxes, names, and distances.
Noclip mode for walking through walls.
Infinite Jump support.
Full Fly mode with keyboard movement controls.
Anti-Void protection teleports player back if falling.
Auto Rejoin reconnects after disconnecting from the server.
Custom hotkey system for toggling modes quickly.
Persistent settings saved to disk or global environment.
Tween animation system and draggable modern UI.
Performance-focused architecture with connection pooling and caching.
Histogram graph for FPS visualization.
Advanced debug and logging utilities.
Modular code structure with reusable utility functions.
